dedupe_keys.name: hydraulic models of the arroyo seco upstream of the brown mountain dam

description: Hydraulic models of the Arroyo Seco upstream of the Brown Mountain Dam is a model listed in HydroShare, an online repository for hydrology data and models, published or maintained by Frame, Jonathan Martin (deposited on HydroShare). This project contains preliminary 1D and 2D hydraulic models for a reach the Arroyo Seco (Los Angeles River tributary) upstream of the Brown Mountain Debris Barrier Dam. These models are not ready for use, they are only a starting point for further analysis. Coverage: United States. The resource was created 2023-06-26 and last updated 2023-06-26; HydroShare lists it as a composite resource. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the HydroShare metadata only, so the files and any paper they support were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the abstract may lag the deposit. It can support infrastructure planning, operations and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hydroshare-infrastructure-resources.
